input.summary: Shorten post-Initial Term exit notice to 30 days, add Kubient renewal reminder 60 days before renewal, and cap renewal pricing changes at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
input.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the notice needed to exit an automatic renewal from 90 to 30 days, asked Kubient to remind us 60 days before each renewal, and capped any renewal-term pricing change at the lesser of CPI and 3%, consistent with our position that renewals be easy to exit and predictably priced. As a fallback we can live with a 60-day notice window and a 5% cap.

ops.oldText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement, or elect not to renew the Term, for any reason following the Initial Term upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other Party. Kubient shall notify Customer in writing at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current Term of the upcoming automatic renewal. Any increase in fees payable by Customer, or reduction in Customer's revenue share, applicable to a renewal term shall not exceed the lesser of (i) the increase in the U.S. Consumer Price Index over the preceding twelve (12) months and (ii) three percent (3%).
